evidence.original_label: 公司自主研发制造的测试设备全球累计装机量 | cumulative_installations
evidence.excerpt:
5、装机规模持续扩大，品牌效应不断增强
  截至报告期末，公司自主研发制造的测试设备全球累计装机量已超过 8,000 台。持续增长的装机规模充分体现了市场对公司产品性能、质量稳定性及服务能力的认可，也为公司后续产品导入、配件销售、技术服务拓展及品牌影响力提升奠定了坚实基础。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: 截至报告期末 = FY2025 annual reporting period end (2025-12-31); global, company-wide cumulative installed systems across all self-developed test-equipment product lines (STS8200 / STS8300 / STS8600), not a single equipment category, not an active-fleet count, and not a period shipment figure. Lower bound only (已超过): do not convert to a point value. Corroborating restatement of the same claim in the same document at physical page 59 (十九、社会责任工作情况): "公司自主研发设备全球累计装机量已突破 8,000 台" (突破, also a lower bound); no separate observation emitted for page 59 under the one-row-per-claim rule, and independent_corroboration remains false because both mentions are the same issuer document. Huafeng is a pure-play semiconductor ATE maker, so a downstream consumer may also legitimately read this company-wide figure as mapping to the `test` category; `all_businesses` is used here because the source clause is company-wide across all product lines.
